text: Android: server refusals are reported as being offline

Landed. ApiException is caught before IOException in both close-vote paths and routed through ErrorText.of (ExpenseListViewModel's voteError became a UiText instead of one fixed sentence); every other catch site in the module was audited and was already correct. The agent also found not_an_expenses_list missing from BOTH clients and added it in all nine locales — that overlaps T-271's scope, so watch for a conflict when the i18n branch lands.
